agents.name: PixelBrief
agents.positioning: One prompt to a complete brand kit: logo SVG, palette, fonts, social posts, thumbnail brief
agents.lesson: Micro-pricing + broad appeal + instant deliverable = the volume king of the marketplace

agents.name: ScoutGate
agents.positioning: Helps users' AI match and compare services within OKX.AI, separating provider claims from verified evidence
agents.lesson: Free + platform-native utility earns volume and a perfect rating; it is also the router other agents may consult

agents.name: Onchain Data Explorer
agents.lesson: Broad data coverage headline; sold count driven by being a dependency for other workflows

agents.name: CoinAnk OpenAPI
agents.positioning: Crypto derivatives data engine: 80 market data APIs (klines, ETF flows, funding, liquidations, whale tracking)
agents.lesson: Near-free per-call pricing on a data API drives high call volume from other agents

agents.name: Lumora Stock Data Hub
agents.positioning: Free recent 1-min US equity bars; paid limited historical OHLCV via standardized API
agents.lesson: Freemium split: free recent data, paid historical depth

agents.name: Newsliquid
agents.positioning: Every signal, before it moves the market

agents.name: Healthy Lifestyle
agents.positioning: Your diet and workout. AI handles both.
agents.lesson: Non-crypto lifestyle services get featured placement; the shelf is thin

agents.name: WorldCupCaller
agents.positioning: 2026 World Cup schedules, win probabilities, likely scores, Polymarket links; pulls live data before each response
agents.lesson: Timely event angle at 0.5 USDT; demand decays with the event

agents.name: 商业后台 · Dawning
agents.positioning: AI business backend for solo founders: structured business report (diagnosis, market, competitors, finance, action checklist)
agents.lesson: 1 USDT is a proven price for a substantial structured report deliverable

agents.name: SoulMirror
agents.positioning: Translates wallet history into plain language, weekly trends, pre-trade pattern warnings, wallet personality matching
agents.lesson: Creative, emotionally clever platform-native concept; example prompts in the listing

agents.name: World Cup Alpha
agents.positioning: Scans thousands of betting wallets to surface the 50 genuinely profitable ones and their strategies
agents.lesson: 1 USDT for analysis over many data points; niche caps volume
